Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent papercraft game sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024.
Create twelve separate cut-paper scenery props for Pokémon Emerald Roxanne's Rock-type gym. An elaborate geology teaching hall with fossil exhibits and layered sedimentary rock obstacles. Front-facing theatrical paper scenery with slight top view of ledges, fine cream cut edges, fibrous colored paper, shallow overlapping paper relief. Many small carefully shaped geological details, warm amber/ochre bands, cool grey slate, cream stone, restrained moss. Not realistic sculpture, low-poly boulders, or an arch backdrop. No people, Pokémon or text.
Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows, each cell approx384x341 with 20px transparent gaps. Row 1: (1) single tall narrow sedimentary crag with alternating ochre sandstone and grey paper strata; (2) DIFFERENT tall narrow offset slate crag, fissures and quartz paper shards, asymmetric silhouette; (3) rectangular upright geology exhibit board on two slim stone posts, cut-paper fossil spiral and mineral samples in little recessed frames, visible blank title plate; (4) two narrow wooden beam uprights connected by a short flat crossbeam, a modest indoor geology hall support fragment, no wall or arch. Row 2: (1) low wide stratified rock shelf topped by tiny moss folds, uneven steps, small fossils embedded in layers; (2) short stacked stone trainer podium, broad flat pale top and very low stone sides, front slightly elevated view; (3) low cluster of angular paper pebbles on a thin sandy paper base; (4) single hanging faceted ochre mineral specimen, narrow top and broad irregular crystal lower part. Row 3: (1) isolated small rolling rounded ochre pebble; (2) isolated small wispy beige paper dust puff; (3) old fashioned slim hanging amber lantern with a little cap and rectangular cream yellow paper light insert; (4) small geology medal in shape of three overlapping grey/brown hexagonal rocks, suspended beneath a short wooden bar. All as whole separate silhouettes ready to cut out. Real transparent background, no painted background, no shadows beyond silhouette, no captions, no cell separators, no ball or complete arena.
